subject: 970 Fellsway Residential Development Proposal
overview: The Davis Companies hosted an informal community engagement meeting to introduce a proposed 289-unit residential redevelopment at 970 Fellsway. Development representatives presented preliminary design plans and answered community questions regarding traffic, building height, and affordability.

items.title: Project Overview and Background
items.summary: Chris Shandor presented background on the Davis Companies and explained the history of the 970 Fellsway site and its proposed Chapter 40B residential path.

items.title: Conceptual Site Design Presentation
items.summary: John Harding outlined the conceptual design plans, including 11 townhomes along Myrtle Street, a six-story residential building, garage parking, and public open space.

items.title: Public Comment and Question Period
items.summary: Neighborhood residents and city officials asked questions and voiced concerns focused primarily on traffic congestion, shadow impacts, building height, utility capacity, and affordability levels.
